_doc: RI-023 fixture. Anthropic ToolResult blocks can carry an is_error: true flag indicating the downstream tool failed. XLI's translate_inbound_to_responses_input CURRENTLY drops is_error entirely (AnthropicContentBlock::ToolResult struct does not declare the field, so serde silently ignores it). The /responses bridge equivalent (FunctionCallOutputPayload.success: Option<bool>) is the documented target; until the closure ships, is_error is lost. This fixture locks the current lossy behavior + annotates the gap so a future fix breaks this test intentionally.

_known_gap.description: Anthropic tool_result is_error flag is silently dropped on the inbound leg. The Responses bridge maps to FunctionCallOutputPayload.success: Some(false); without the inbound plumbing, the harness loses the error signal and the model retries blind.
_known_gap.fix_location: spokes/xli/codex-rs/codex-api/src/messages_server/inbound.rs — add is_error to AnthropicContentBlock::ToolResult + thread to FunctionCallOutputPayload.success
